Methodology

How we read a rate card.

  1. We read prices only from the provider’s own pricing page, documentation or public pricing API.
  2. Each row records the source URL and the date we read it. If we cannot read a number, the row is marked Unverified and the price is left blank.
  3. We show standard (pay-as-you-go, global) list prices. Models with a published long-context tier expose a long_context object (threshold + rates); the finder and calculator apply that tier when the prompt/context need exceeds the threshold. Regional, data-residency and priority variants are noted, not blended.
  4. A weekly script snapshots every source page and diffs it against the last snapshot. Changes are confirmed by hand before entering the change log.
  5. Gateway rows (OpenRouter) are the gateway’s own list price, which may differ from the upstream provider.
